method: Same aec09d6 core source two-run one-lifetime pilot original-A/candidate-B. Both one/native bank, current mask and peak, same allocation/raster/draw/upload/artist code; only the complete CardRasterCache class module differs at the exact current PaintedCardBatches import. Budget-only complete-class policy: sole source difference is constructor default 48MiB to16MiB. Codec/get/put/clear/stats/admission/backoff algorithm bytes are otherwise unchanged; no ghost or probation fields. Cache and CPU ownership/cost changes are reported, not asserted equal. GPU rasterization/upload/copy counts, page layout, geometry and render order remain strict invariants. All original raw samples retained from one lifetime per policy, not selected or averaged quantiles. All 6 PNGs are decoded and compared at zero RGBA tolerance; original-A supplies three phase/lifetime image oracles.

cacheMetadataAccounting.reason: Neither class implements probation or admission metadata; absent raw fields remain absent, and validation fields are null/not applicable. Existing encoded-entry Map/key/object metadata and process memory are not measured by declared buffer ownership.

limits: Pilot: one original then one candidate lifetime, no ABBA balance and only 60CPU/12real per policy. Order drift, stable tails, hardware generalization and definite shipping speed are unresolved. All original samples/cold first/slow frames are retained. Complete wall is GPU-completion/scheduling, not GPU nanoseconds/FPS.

Budget-only constructor-default policy is tested on aec09d6, not integrated production and not the entire historical renderer. Budget-dependent cache counters, true Canvas misses and CPU ownership may differ. No probation/admission/ghost stats exist; validation fields must be absent or null as specified, not invented zeros. Encoded entries are capped at1024; existing JS entry metadata bytes remain unmeasured. Stage/cache work costs are cumulative, not only timed CPU rows; avoidedPaintMs is an estimate, not measured total frame benefit.
Full/World3D/Canvas timings are nested/residual and cannot be added. Cold real samples remain in headline values. No allocation profiler or GC attribution.
